text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with Ethereum's decline slightly steeper, suggesting some rotation away from alts toward BTC's relative safety. The Fear & Greed Index sits in Greed territory at 64 but has declined 10 points over a week, signaling cooling enthusiasm after a recent run-up. Bitcoin's dominance at 58.8% and $100B daily volume point to steady participation without panic or euphoria—a market consolidating recent gains rather than capitulating or accelerating.
